slides.headline: You stop composing the query
slides.body: Most of the effort in using an assistant is translating what you want into a sentence it will accept. That step disappears when it can see the thing.

slides.headline: It's listening while you're connected
slides.body: Camera and voice go to Google's Gemini live during a session so it can answer. Argus tells you that before you start, and nothing runs when you're not connected.
